conventions.major_arcmin: apparent major-axis diameter, arcmin (definition in axes_def: D25 = 25 B-mag/arcsec^2 isophote; a26 (Holmberg) is ~1.3x D25; 2 r_h = half-light diameter)
conventions.minor_arcmin: apparent minor-axis diameter, same isophote (null: unknown)
conventions.pa_deg: position angle of the major axis, degrees North through East, J2000, 0..180
conventions.incl_deg: inclination of the disk, 0 = face-on (disks only); the near side is not known
conventions.shape: disk (thin oriented disk) or spheroid (E/dE/dSph: drawn as a camera-facing ellipse)
conventions.mag: apparent magnitude copied from the first catalogue entry that has one (mag_band, mag_src)
conventions.kind/docs/facts/facts_ref: docs/content-contract.md section 3 (facts: major_kpc/minor_kpc at the primary entry's catalogue distance, inclination_deg, position_angle_deg, type)
conventions.keys: every name/alias of the merged catalogue entries (viewer looks shapes up by catalogKey)

hyperleda.ref: HyperLEDA, Makarov et al. 2014, A&A 570, A13 (live database, meandata table; fields logd25, logr25, pa, incl, t, type)

openngc.ref: Verga, OpenNGC v20260501 (CC-BY-SA-4.0); galaxy axes/PA/Hubble type from LEDA

leda2003.ref: Paturel et al. 2003, A&A 412, 45 (HYPERLEDA I, VizieR VII/237; PA precessed B1950 -> J2000)

ungc.ref: Karachentsev, Makarov & Kaisina 2013, AJ 145, 101 (UNGC, VizieR J/AJ/145/101; a26 = Holmberg diameter, i = inclination)

mcc.ref: McConnachie 2012, AJ 144, 4 (Jan 2021 update; r_h, e = 1 - b/a, PA)

derived.ref: Derived here from b/a with intrinsic thickness q0 = 0.2 (Hubble 1926, ApJ 64, 321)

simbad.ref: Wenger et al. 2000, A&AS 143, 9 (SIMBAD; used only to find PGC numbers)
